from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def fun(p):
    A=np.column_stack([T**3/(1+p[0]*eps),np.log(1+eps)**2,np.ones_like(T)])
    c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma,rcond=None)
    return sigma-A@c
r=least_squares(fun,[0.5],bounds=(0,50))
A=np.column_stack([T**3/(1+r.x[0]*eps),np.log(1+eps)**2,np.ones_like(T)])
c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma,rcond=None)
print("k",r.x,"coef",c, np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(sigma))
res=sigma-A@c
eb=np.digitize(eps,np.linspace(0.2,5,6)[1:-1]); tb=np.digitize(T,np.linspace(2,6,5)[1:-1])
M=np.zeros((5,4))
for i in range(5):
  for j in range(4):
    m=(eb==i)&(tb==j)
    M[i,j]=res[m].mean() if m.sum() else np.nan
